nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: App Router page for the /projects route that renders every entry from the shared projects content module as a responsive two-column grid of image-led cards with tech-stack stickers and external links. Composes the Reveal, TiltCard and WavyRule motion primitives around otherwise static server-rendered markup.
nodes.languageNotes: Next.js App Router server component: it exports a `metadata` object for per-route SEO and stays server-rendered while delegating all interactivity to the imported "use client" motion wrappers.

nodes.name: ProjectsPage
nodes.summary: Default-exported page component that maps over the projects array to emit one card per project, alternating reveal delays by column and cycling a rotation class across tech tags to give them a hand-placed sticker look.

nodes.name: WavyRule.tsx
nodes.summary: Client component providing a decorative horizontal divider drawn as a soft SVG wave that animates its stroke into view on scroll. Used as a section separator across the home, contact, experience and projects pages.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses framer-motion's `pathLength` with `whileInView` and `viewport.once` so the stroke draws itself exactly once; `useReducedMotion` short-circuits to a fully drawn path for accessibility.

nodes.name: WavyRule
nodes.summary: Renders an aria-hidden SVG quadratic-curve path whose stroke animates from zero to full length when scrolled into view, respecting the user's reduced-motion preference.

nodes.name: TiltCard.tsx
nodes.summary: Client-side motion wrapper that applies a subtle spring-damped 3D tilt to its children as the cursor moves across them. Used to add depth to project and experience cards.
nodes.languageNotes: Drives rotation through framer-motion `useMotionValue` piped into `useSpring`, keeping the tilt off the React render path so pointer moves never trigger re-renders.

nodes.name: TiltCard
nodes.summary: Wraps children in a motion.div that converts cursor position within the element's bounding box into clamped rotateX/rotateY motion values, easing them back to zero on mouse leave and disabling the effect under reduced motion.

nodes.name: projects.ts
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for portfolio project entries, exporting a typed `Project[]` array with name, period, subtitle, description, cover image, tech stack and external links for each project. Consumed by both the projects page and the home page.
nodes.languageNotes: Content-as-code pattern: the `Project` and `ProjectLink` types are declared alongside the data and the array is annotated `Project[]`, so schema drift in any entry surfaces as a compile-time error rather than a runtime render bug.
